dialogues.speaker: Mr. Bohuan
dialogues.text: I was moved by the sight of the crystal-clear water as it flows off into eternity, never to return. So I stopped here to let it enrich my mind as I recite a few lines of poetry.

dialogues.speaker: Mr. Bohuan
dialogues.text: Look, traveler. This crystal clear river bifurcates at Dihua Marsh, one stream flowing north to become the sweet spring from which Mondstadt's wineries draw their water, the other flowing south into the sea and into infinity...

dialogues.speaker: Mr. Bohuan
dialogues.text: A cry of joy wells up in me: Behold, 'tis nature's majesty!
